_readme: Settings for the optional Jev lane. Your API key does NOT go here: put JEV_API_KEY=... in a file called .env (git-ignored). mode: 'auto' = use Jev if a key is set, else show 'not connected'; 'off' = never call it; 'mock' = fake answers (clearly labelled) for testing the comparison view.
_docs: API reference: https://docs.typesafe.ai/api/system-one . Models: GET /v1/models (jev-latest, jev-preview).
